$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, for editors: a path relative to the file (e.g. ../schemas/policy.schema.json, as 'stratarec schema --out schemas' writes them) or a URL. The engine ignores it: it is not part of the file's content id.

experiment_patchable.description: RFC 6901 prefixes experiments may add, delete and modify under.

experiment_add_only.description: RFC 6901 prefixes experiments may only add new entries under.

owners.description: RFC 6901 prefix → owning teams that must approve changes (mapped to code review).

log_bytes_per_request_budget.description: Estimated log bytes per request allowed per pipeline (design 8.6).
